record.title: Lebanon–Syria COVID passenger closure regimes and phased exceptions, 2020–2021
record.scope: Masnaa / Jdeidet Yabous; Abboudieh and other official Lebanon–Syria land posts
record.crossings: Masnaa / Jdeidet Yabous; Abboudieh and other official Lebanon–Syria land posts
record.direction: Separate directions: Lebanese entry controls and Syrian entry controls. December endpoint principally Lebanese nationals entering Syria.
record.movement: Passengers, with nationality and direction-specific exceptions
record.exceptions: Freight exempt; Lebanese family return slots in June 2020, partial Masnaa/Abboudieh reopening reported March 2021, Lebanese admission into Syria eased December 2021.
record.imposing_authority: Lebanese and Syrian governments, with direction-specific orders
record.enforcement: Scope-limited evidence; uniform enforcement beyond the named crossings and movement categories is not inferred.
record.relationship: Promotes ME-L02 while preserving country/direction distinctions and intermediate exceptions. Future splitting requires complete per-direction chronology.
record.status_observation: Historical evidence in cited sources only; no present-status inference.
record.context: Lebanon restricted land arrivals in March; Syria issued a later March passenger ban. Selective return permissions and conditional openings punctuated the regime.
record.uncertainty: Aggregate phase record, not a continuous bilateral closure. Lebanon announced 18 March 2020 implementation; Syria separately announced a ban effective midnight Tuesday after 22 March. Detailed 2021 admission categories remain incomplete. December is further partial easing, not first or full reopening.
